privacy.contactLabel: Questions about this policy or your data? Email:

sections.title: Using the app as a guest
sections.body: If you don't sign in, BioBand works entirely on your device. Nothing you do — recordings, practice progress, settings — is sent anywhere, and none of it is kept between app launches: closing and reopening the app resets it to a fresh state.

sections.title: Signing in with Google or Apple
sections.body:
You can sign in with Google or with Sign in with Apple. Either one is used only to authenticate you and to give your profile a name to start from. Signing in lets the following small pieces of data sync to our cloud database, so they follow you across devices:

• Your display name, favorite instrument, and profile photo URL
• Practice progress: streaks, total practice time, completed challenges, earned badges
• Your practice-reminder time preference

Exactly what each provider gives us:

• Google — your name, your e-mail address, and the URL of your profile photo.
• Apple — your name and your e-mail address. Apple sends the name only the very first time you authorize BioBand and never again; we use it to prefill your display name, which you can change at any time. Apple does not give us a photo. If you choose Hide My Email, Apple gives us a private relay address (…@privaterelay.appleid.com) instead of your real one, and that relay address is the only address we ever see.

This data is tied to your account and is only ever read or written by you (enforced server-side, not just in the app).

sections.title: What we never collect or upload
sections.body: Your recordings, Studio projects, imported songs, and any audio you create or import stay only on your device. We do not upload, transmit, back up, or have any access to your audio. We also do not collect analytics, advertising identifiers, or track your activity in other apps or on other websites.

sections.title: Feature counters
sections.body: If you sign in, your profile row also carries a small set of counters: how many times you have opened Tutorial Mode, finished a tutorial, opened Studio or the Drum Machine, saved a recording, imported a file, or made a backup. These are running totals only — no timestamps, no order of actions, nothing about which song or file was involved. They exist so we can see which parts of the app nobody finds. They live in your own row under the same protection as the rest of your data. In guest mode nothing is uploaded, counters included.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body:
• Google Sign-In — used solely for authentication. See Google's Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy) for how Google handles your account data.
• Sign in with Apple — used solely for authentication. Apple tells us your name (once) and an e-mail address, which may be a private relay address if you asked Apple to hide your real one. See Apple's Privacy Policy (apple.com/legal/privacy) for how Apple handles your account data.
• Our cloud database — a third-party hosting provider we use only to store the small progress/settings data described above.

sections.title: Your rights (KVKK / GDPR)
sections.body:
The developer of BioBand acts as the data controller for the account data described above (contact: the email below). Because our cloud database may host data outside Türkiye/the EU, choosing to sync your account data means you consent to this transfer.

Depending on your country's law — including Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) and the EU's GDPR — you have the right to: learn whether your data is being processed, request information about it, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, object to its processing, and seek compensation for damages caused by unlawful processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the email below.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body:
• Sign out at any time from Profile → Settings. This immediately clears all data stored on that device and returns the app to a fresh guest state.
• Delete your account permanently: Profile → Settings → Delete account. This permanently removes your account and all progress/settings data in the cloud, then clears the data on this device. It cannot be undone.
• If you would rather request deletion without installing the app, contact us at the e-mail below.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a new "Last updated" date.

quotes.text: The moment you fear losing is the moment you have lost.
quotes.author: Bilal Gürkan Şanlı

quotes.text: Without music, life would be a mistake.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: I was obliged to be industrious. Whoever is equally industrious will succeed just as well.
quotes.author: Johann Sebastian Bach

quotes.text: Music expresses that which cannot be said and on which it is impossible to be silent.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.text: From the heart — may it return to the heart.
quotes.author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quotes.text: There are two kinds of music: good music, and the other kind.
quotes.author: Duke Ellington

quotes.text: Master your instrument, master the music, then forget all of it and just play.
quotes.author: Charlie Parker

quotes.text: I am ninety-three, and I still practise every day, because I think I am making progress.
quotes.author: Pablo Casals

quotes.text: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
quotes.author: Thomas Edison

quotes.text: Practice does not make perfect. Only perfect practice makes perfect.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.text: You do not have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.text: Melody is the essence of music.
quotes.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: Music was my refuge. I could crawl into the space between the notes.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou
